pearls.purpose: Stateless multi-chain JSON-RPC proxy. Cyberteller's only network path to chain providers (Solana, Ethereum). Polls per-invoice deposit addresses and broadcasts pre-signed transactions on demand. No keys, no state, no scheduler — pure HTTP-to-RPC adapter.

encryption.scheme: n/a — stateless proxy, no persistent secrets

adminOnly.name: Operator
adminOnly.purpose: Full HTTP access to all endpoints. Cyberteller's only consumer claims this role via Powerbox.

blockchains.purpose: Read-only address polling + broadcast of pre-signed tx bytes. ChainWatch never derives a key, never signs.
ERC-20 Transfer log scan + native ETH transfer scan + raw-tx broadcast.

httpOut.purpose: JSON-RPC against the configured chain endpoints. URLs are operator-set via env vars (SOL_RPC_URL, ETH_RPC_URL); defaults point at Solana devnet + Ethereum sepolia public nodes.

http.name: GET /api/check/{chain}/{address}
http.purpose: Query the chain RPC for incoming transfers to the watched address. Cyberteller polls this every 30s per pending invoice.

http.name: POST /api/broadcast
http.purpose: Broadcast a pre-signed transaction (raw bytes) supplied in the request body. Returns the chain-side tx hash.

http.name: GET /healthz
http.purpose: Liveness check. Returns the list of configured chains.
